sum: Octave Intelligence plc provides various software solutions. Its solutions helps organizations to better understand and manage the environment in which they design, build, operate, and protect their assets, people, and critical infrastructure. Its platform connects data, events, and workflows across various environments and applies context-aware intelligence to help customers understand what is happening, what may happen next, and how actions in one area affect conditions in another. The company chemicals and petrochemicals, electronics, life sciences and pharma, public safety, construction, manufacturing, security, engineering services (EPCs), data centers, food, beverage and retail, metals and mining, transportation, defence, government and public sector, oil and gas, education, healthcare, and power and utilities industries. It operates in the United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, India, Africa, and rest of APAC region. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Madison, Alabama.
ceo: Mr. Mattias  Stenberg B.Sc., B.Sc. (Econ.) (CEO & Director)
